text: Dedicated to the Community. FROM the Community, FOR the Community.

I am the only candidate born, raised, and a lifelong resident of Huntington Park. I attended Miles Avenue Elementary, Gage Middle School, and Huntington Park High School. For over 20 years, I have served our community's children and families through LAUSD. I earned a Bachelor's degree from University of California, Los Angeles, a Master's degree from Cal State University, Long Beach, and a Doctorate from Cal State University, Fullerton.
When you previously elected me to the Huntington Park City Council, I:

- Got the City out of debt; balanced every budget
- Expanded park programs, including basketball, baseball, and softball.
- Helped bring Target, Farmer Boys, Raising Cane's, Smart & Final, CVS, and Ross.
- Increased programs for seniors and students.
- Provided free monthly food for seniors and families.
- Funded summer tutoring for Huntington Park children.
- Increased public safety and reduced crime.
- Secured $200 monthly for 12 months for over 1,000 senior citizens.
- Created the City's First-Time Homebuyer Program with down-payment assistance.

I'm running again because the current council majority has cut senior services, park and food programs, and public safety while giving the City Manager authority to spend up to $100,000 without City Council approval or public transparency. I will fight for our families and restore the programs our community deserves.

text: My goal is to work with fellow City Council colleagues and respective stakeholders in these efforts:

- More public safety, parking solutions, city services
- Continue to pursue Costco & Salt Lake Park Pool Community Center
- New UCLA or USC Community Hospital (expand medical care capacity, emergency services, beds, specialties etc.)
- California corner destination/entertainment venue (redevelopment of Alameda/Randolph/Santa Fe/Slauson with mixed uses (commercial, needed residential, retail) and advocate for future MTA rail stop
- Award competitive contracts with quality services/goods
- City Beautification (save water/money with dessert theme designs in homes/street medians with jacaranda and/or cherry blossom trees)
- Diverse Quality Shops/Restaurants (Macys, Big Bear, Angus Steakhouse etc.)

My parents came to this country and attained the American Dream. With their support and opportunity our country offers, I graduated from Huntington Park High School and the University of Southern California (USC). I own my home since 1988 and have lived in this city for 50 years.
I worked for the Port of Los Angeles and the Los Angeles Department of Water and Power (LADWP) for 35 years, the largest seaport and public utility in the country, respectively.
I'm an International Brotherhood of Electrical Workers (IBEW) union member and current president of the Huntington Park Kiwanis Club.
Hard work and a vision make a difference.
With your vote, I'll continue to work for the City of Huntington Park with integrity and professionalism.
